sources.articleTitle: Watch: PM Modi visits Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan in Manila, offers prayers

headline: Prime Minister Narendra Modi Visits Historic Manila Gurudwara
metaDescription: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the historic Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan in Manila while attending the 49th ASEAN Summit in the Philippines.
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan in Manila during his attendance at the 49th ASEAN Summit.
The visit included prayers and participation from local dignitaries, including Senator Francis Joseph Escudero.
Established in 1901, the Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan is recognized as the oldest Sikh place of worship in the Philippines.
aiContextParagraph: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently participated in the 49th ASEAN Summit held in the Philippines. During his diplomatic visit, he toured the Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan located in Manila to offer prayers. The event was attended by prominent figures, such as Senator Francis Joseph Escudero. The Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan holds historical significance as it was established in 1901 and serves as a central hub for the local Sikh community. The visit was documented by the Prime Minister through social media, where he conveyed his gratitude. This engagement highlights the ongoing diplomatic activities associated with the ASEAN summit, which brings together leaders from across the region to discuss international cooperation and regional policy matters, while also providing opportunities for visiting officials to engage with local cultural and religious institutions present within the host nation.
